From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: ScribeHealth Security <security@scribehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit log evidence & retention — onboarding items and next steps

Hi Alyssa — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the items we'd like to collect to keep the SOC/GDPR/HIPAA review moving: 

1) Artifacts you can share now (if available):
  - Latest SOC 2 report (or excerpt) relevant to logging and change control
  - Any existing log retention policy language (PDF/URL)
  - A point-of-contact for InfoSec who will handle the vendor questionnaire

2) Technical scoping items we discussed (examples):
  - Types of logs you need exported: admin activity, auth events, API request/response (headers removed), system alerts.
  - Preferred export formats: NDJSON or gzipped CSV; we can support S3 delivery or direct HTTPS pulls.
  - Immutability needs: WORM-style retention vs. write-once object store — please indicate if you require signed, time-stamped immutability or legal-hold snapshots.

3) Timeline / next steps:
  - If you can share the SOC2 excerpt + any retention policy by Thu, Apr 22, we will draft a short technical evidence pack and fill the questionnaire.
  - If InfoSec prefers, we can run a 30-minute technical deep-dive focused just on exportability and immutability next week.

Attached: redwood-auditlog-capabilities.pdf — short summary of the admin/API audit data we ship and available export options.

Best,
Naomi

- Export formats: S3 delivery preferred (NDJSON ok).
- Immutability: We need ability to produce tamper-evident exports for legal requests; long-term retention will be handled on our side but we require signed export manifests.
- Logs in scope: admin activity, API requests (including caller ID, timestamp, route), authentication events.

We'll complete the questionnaire sections for required evidence and then schedule the technical deep-dive. Proposed window: Tue/Wed next week morning PT.
